text.en: This Order may be cited as the Prime Minister Corporation (Dissolution) Order. Dissolution of Prime Minister Corporation in S 55/1960
The Prime Minister Corporation referred to in section 2(1) of the repealed Constitution (Prime Minister Incorporation) Order, 1960 is hereby dissolved.
